purpose: Executable minimal Worldwright alpha command and native GUI acceptance contract. A registered command is not automatically a verified alpha feature.

categories.required_workflow: Both real native executables compile; version/command catalog respond without display server
Create blank drawing, edit, undo/redo, save/reopen .dftba, preserve exact 2D/3D and object names; reopen legacy .bcraft
Draw in 2D from a blank document; show coordinates and editable layers; save/reopen
Author exact curve and control surface; preview/edit/transform without replacing exact source with tessellation
Create/edit/select polygon meshes; inspect boundaries, reject degeneracy and preserve source faces
3D viewport orbit/pan/zoom, click/toggle selection and transform gizmo, snapping and construction plane
Maintain layers and hierarchy on save/reopen with stable identity
Same typed geometry math through CAD and OrbWeaver, deterministic graph evaluation, visible editable graph canvas and bake into document
.dftba native roundtrip and .bcraft migration; at least DXF and STL/OBJ interchange with measured loss, no false claim of exact B-Rep exchange
Start native window; 2D and 3D palettes share one command line, no document revision on workspace change; stable selection, keyboard focus, viewport/gizmo, menus and accessibility settings

blocking_gaps: Validate the native GUI on actual Windows, macOS and Linux displays; building + --version is not a GUI interaction test
OrbWeaver visual graph canvas and persistent graph editing must be exercised in the compiled UI
Verify basic solid creation/editing and expected Boolean/trim operations against concrete geometry fixtures
Complete and test STL/OBJ import/export and surface/mesh attribute fidelity through GUI/API
Measure reopen/undo/history reproducibility and memory under a representative mixed 2D/3D model
Haiku native build remains an experimental target
release_decision: FAIL unless all P0 workflows and native UI review are verified. Compiled smoke passing alone must not be described as alpha-complete.
